title: Psalms 138
paragraphs: ¹ I will praise you, LORD, with all my heart; before the gods I will sing your praise. ² I will bow down toward your holy temple and praise your name for your faithful love and your faithfulness, for you have exalted your name and your word above all things. ³ When I called, you answered me; you made me bold and strengthened me in my soul. ⁴ All the kings of the earth will praise you, LORD, when they hear what you have promised. ⁵ They will sing about the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.

⁶ Though the LORD is exalted, he takes notice of the humble, but the proud he knows from a distance. ⁷ Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you preserve my life. You stretch out your hand against the anger of my enemies; your right hand saves me. ⁸ The LORD will fulfill his purpose for me; your faithful love, LORD, endures forever — do not abandon the works of your hands.
